=====Episode 2 Title: Sharp Confrontation｜00:15‑00:30=====
[Shot 5] At 00:15.000, medium shot. <Subject 1> (S1) Lin Feng presses one hand firmly onto Gu Zhiwan’s tablet surface, eyes sharp, body leans forward, says with suppressed anger, <d>[Chinese]样本不重要！殖民星会被裂隙吞噬！人命摆在你面前！</d>
[Shot 6] At 00:19.000, medium shot. <Subject 2> (S2) Gu Zhiwan swings off Lin Feng’s pressing hand, smart wrist‑watch pops out three‑dimensional data projection above wrist, retorts sharply, <d>[Chinese]你根本不懂！这个样本，是人类跨越星际的唯一希望！</d>
[Shot 7] At 00:24.000, wide shot. Brief gravity failure occurs in cabin, scattered sundries suspend floating in air. <Subject 1> (S1) draws out waist emergency sealing device, facial expression turns ice‑cold, <d>[Chinese]我是现场指挥官，我有权强制执行封核。</d>
[Shot 8] At 00:28.000, medium shot. <Subject 2> (S2) Gu Zhiwan moves sideways to block main‑control console, uses own body to block Lin Feng’s path. Hold frame until episode cut at 00:30.000.

=====Episode 3 Title: Dangerous Warning｜00:30‑00:45=====
[Shot 9] At 00:30.000, medium shot. <Subject 2> (S2) Gu Zhiwan eyes alert, speaks fast, <d>[Chinese]你启动封核，会直接引爆裂隙，我们所有人都会死在这里！</d>
[Shot 10] At 00:34.000, close‑up shot for <Subject 1> (S1). Lin Feng freezes in position, eyebrows tighten heavily, shows obvious doubt, <d>[Chinese]你在说谎，方案报告里没有这个风险！</d>
[Shot 11] At 00:38.000, medium close‑up for <Subject 2> (S2). Gu Zhiwan does not evade eye contact, tone calm and ruthless, <d>[Chinese]报告是我修改过的。我从一开始，就没打算关闭裂隙。</d>
[Shot 12] At 00:42.000, wide shot. Red alarm light fills most cabin space, fine cracks spread on cabin wall surface, console countdown shows 32 seconds remaining. Hold frame until episode cut at 00:45.000.

=====Episode 4 Title: Hidden Truth｜00:45‑01:00=====

[Shot 14] At 00:49.000, medium shot. Gu Zhiwan lifts tablet, hidden confidential data projection unfolds in front of two people, <d>[Chinese]殖民星早就已经被暗物质侵蚀，覆灭是定局。裂隙不是灾难，是逃生通道！</d>
[Shot 15] At 00:54.000, close‑up of <Subject 1> (S1), Lin Feng stares at floating data projection, <d>[Chinese]那为什么要隐瞒？</d>
[Shot 16] At 00:58.000, medium shot of <Subject 2> (S2), Gu Zhiwan’s figure shivers slightly under violent cabin vibration. Hold frame until episode cut at 01:00.000.

=====Episode 5 Title: Desperate Gamble｜01:00‑01:15=====
[Shot 17] At 01:00.000, medium shot of <Subject 2> (S2), Gu Zhiwan speaks with heavy tone, <d>[Chinese]高层不会接受赌上全站人员的冒险，他们只会选择保守毁灭。我只能篡改报告，把所有人逼到绝境。</d>

[Shot 19] At 01:10.000, close‑up for <Subject 2> (S2), her voice drops low, heavy emotion, <d>[Chinese]百分之三十七。失败，我们全部化为粒子。</d>
[Shot 20] At 01:13.000, console close‑up, countdown number shows 8 seconds left, alarm sharp sound reaches peak intensity. Hold frame until episode cut at 01:15.000.
